A formal ceremony honoring Coach Byrd will be held later that evening on the football field. A separate email will be sent with more details about the formal ceremony.
Thank you,

After 27 years, Antony Byrd is retiring from his position as coach of the Eastview Eagles football team.

Light refreshments and cake will be provided. This event is for faculty and staff only. We don't want to get in trouble with the fire marshal for having additional people show up. A formal ceremony honoring Coach Byrd will be held later that evening on the football field. A separate email will be sent with more details about the formal ceremony.
Thank you,

textContent.text: As a reminder, everyone serving as security for our various clients is expected to adhere to certain dress codes.

There are two ways to achieve maximum impact with what you wear. One team will dress conspicuously as a security detail and accompany the group's members as they greet and take pictures with fans outside the venue. Inside the event, a second security team will wear formal attire. Female bodyguards should wear evening gowns or cocktail dresses, while male bodyguards should wear tuxedos.
I know I can count on all of you to maintain the utmost level of professionalism and vigilance. Our clients' safety is our number one priority.

contents.text: A modifier is a word or phrase that modifies, or describes, another word or phrase.

header.text: A misplaced modifier is a modifier that appears to modify the wrong word or phrase because it is too far from the word or phrase that it should modify.

sentences.text: Winston saw monkeys and peacocks on vacation in India.
This sentence has a misplaced modifier. It wrongly suggests that the monkeys and peacocks were on vacation.
On vacation in India, Winston saw monkeys and peacocks.
This sentence correctly suggests that Winston was on vacation.

header.text: A dangling modifier is a modifier that appears to modify the wrong word or phrase because the word or phrase that it should modify is missing from the sentence.

sentences.text: Trying to fall asleep, the sheets felt uncomfortably hot.
This sentence has a dangling modifier. It wrongly suggests that the sheets were trying to fall asleep.
Trying to fall asleep, I felt uncomfortably hot in the sheets.
This sentence correctly suggests that I was trying to fall asleep.
